summary: Bengaluru's underground electronic scene is busy and paid-social heavy: promoters like Bloom In Green, Oddvision, Sort My Scene and Echonyx run specific, fact-led Meta ads (artist origin, label credits, set times, venue, price), usually several variants of one promise. Pet events are also plentiful but are daytime, family or wellness formats. Nobody found pairs pets with underground music, which is CCD x Social's whole idea. Discovery runs through ticketing apps (District, Insider, HighApe, SortMyScene, Skillboxes), which creates a gap CCD's artist directory and gig scraper can fill.
